news.why: Two-sided into Friday's early close. 7305–09 is still the control line: Monday tagged it (ES high 7313.25 at 7:32 AM PT) and sold off. Tuesday held 7152–7240. Wednesday's 5:30 AM PT data (GDP 4.3% vs 3.5% expected, core PCE 3.3% year-on-year vs 3.2% expected, claims 189k vs 200k, durable goods 0.2% vs 0.7%) flushed ES to 6982.50 at 6:45 AM PT — just above the 6960–66 Monday pivot and a slight undercut of the 6992–93 Sunday overnight low — then ripped to 7211 at 10:50 AM PT, an exact test of the 7211–23 prior highs. As of 11:28 AM PT: ES 7197, SPX 7185, SPY 716.99, QQQ 632.99, NDX 26008.65, VIX 27.97 (Wednesday high 34.95 at 6:45 AM PT). Tuesday closes were SPX 7201.09 (+4.21% vs Friday), SPY 718.78, QQQ 638.10, VIX 26.36. The Monday plan's bull path played out in full and then some: 7025 was reclaimed Sunday, and price ran through 7086, 7120–25 and 7211–23 to tag 7305–09. The bear path to 6897 never triggered; Wednesday's 6982.50 low held the 6960–66 pivot. Friday is a half day (stocks close 10:00 AM PT) and weekly expiration. ES ≈ SPX + 13.5 (Wednesday regular-session median through 11:18 AM PT; the session is still open). The last full options board is Friday's close — not current.
